question: Which year has the lowest speed of lap time?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "race_results_with_year" AS SELECT r.raceid, ra.year, r.driverid, r.fastestlapspeed FROM table_11 AS r INNER JOIN table_1 AS ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH per_year AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    MIN(fastestlapspeed) AS min_fastestlap_speed
  FROM race_results_with_year
  WHERE fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year
), best AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    min_fastestlap_speed
  FROM per_year
  WHERE min_fastestlap_speed = (SELECT MIN(min_fastestlap_speed) FROM per_year)
  ORDER BY year ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM best;
